borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1
borders.description: Divider (`#2B2B2B`): 1pt hairlines between rows inside settings / profile screens.

borders.label: 边框 2 - Border 2
borders.description: Netflix's iOS app is a cinematic dark canvas where poster art does all the heavy lifting. From the moment you pick a profile, you're dropped into a screen that feels less like a traditional app and more like a black-box theater: the canvas is `#141414` (a warm true-dark charcoal used across every Netflix surface since the brand's modern refresh), and every row of content is a horizontal strip of 2:3 vertical poster tiles separated only by titles and the faintest of whitespace. The top of every Home screen is a full-bleed hero — no app-logo header, no search bar at the top — where a trailer auto-plays muted over the selected title's key art, fading from the full landscape bleed at the top into the dark canvas via a vertical gradient that eats away at the bottom third of the image. You scroll, and rows of posters flow under your thumb like film strips.

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: The accent system is singular and sacred: Netflix Red (`#E50914`). It appears in exactly three places — the word "NETFLIX" at the top of the feed (the only header element, a wordmark), the large red Play button on the hero and every detail page, and the notification badges. Nothing else in the UI is red. Everything else — text, surface elevation, buttons that aren't Play — lives in a narrow monochrome palette: white (`#FFFFFF`), muted white (`#AAAAAA`), a near-black deep gray (`#1F1F1F`) for raised surfaces, and the canvas (`#141414`) itself. When Netflix wants to signal a different profile, it rotates a small palette of saturated accent colors (red, blue, yellow, green) on the circular avatars of the profile picker — but those never leak into the main app chrome.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use {#141414} as the canvas — warm dark charcoal, not pure black (except behind hero art)。
建议：Reserve Netflix Red ({#E50914}) for the NETFLIX wordmark, Play button, and Continue Watching progress bar — nothing else。
建议：Use the red wordmark as the ONLY header on Home — no text title, no search bar in the top app bar。
建议：Render posters at a 2:3 aspect ratio with a 4pt corner radius — Netflix's signature tile。
建议：Use the vertical gradient from canvas to transparent to fade hero images into the background。
dont: 避免：use pure black {#000000} as the canvas — {#141414} is warmer and the Netflix standard。
避免：ship a light mode — Netflix has always been dark-only。
避免：use green for success (downloaded, checkmark states) — Netflix uses gray。
避免：use a full-pill corner on the Play button — 4pt is signature。
避免：use red anywhere other than the defined brand moments — no red borders, no red text, no red accent on metadata。
